name: Jiangsu General Science Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu General Science Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of tires in China and internationally. It offers steel radial tires, including short-distance industrial and mining tires, medium and short-distance load-bearing tires, medium and long-distance road transport tires, light truck tires, etc.; semi-steel radial tire products, such as family car tires, urban off-road tires, off-road tires, and commercial truck tires; bias tires; and cycle tires. The company provides its products under the CELIMO, GOODTRIP, TBBTRIES, CHITUMA, and TOWIN brands. It serves automobile manufacturers, construction machinery factories, tire dealers, and consumers. …
